newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nichiboshin sees loss from unit's dissolution.
newsitem.headline: Nichiboshin sees loss from unit's dissolution.

text.p: Nichiboshin Ltd said on Friday that it expects to lose 14.50 billion yen from the dissolution of a unit but kept its earnings forecast unchanged for the year to March 31.
Nichiboshin, a non-bank, said it had decided to disband its Tokyo-based financial subsidiary as part of a restructuring of its business.

It said its lending to the unit totalled 28.18 billion yen and the dissolution would result in a loss of 14.50 billion yen. The expected loss would be included in Nichiboshin's earnings for the year to March 31, it said.
Nichiboshin said that as the loss had already been included in its 1996/97 earnings forecast announced on May 24 last year, it would not be revising that estimate.
The firm said in May that it expected its parent current earnings to be at break-even point and a parent net profit of 16.80 billion yen.
